text: The Board confirms that each of these nominees is qualified to serve under the provisions of the City of Toronto's Public Appointments Policy and the Relationship Framework for Community Centre Boards of Management. On behalf of the Board, I respectfully request that the City take the necessary steps to appoint these nominated candidates. Please note that Paul Saguil and Min Oh have resigned (end-of-term), effective September 25, 2024.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following individuals to the 519 Church Street Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending September 27, 2028: - Aaron Hewitt - Victor Huynh - Juan Camilo Rendon Ocampo - Erika Voaklander - Dennis Yu
